FACT_ID: sec02-R01 | anchor: A01
The two year clean record requirement applies to getting the learner's permit, while the six month clean record requirement applies to getting the junior driver's license [A01].
Why it matters: group clean record clocks; difficulty medium; prereq sec02-F03; confusables sec02-F03, sec02-F07
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-vt-class-std:vermont-department-of-motor-vehicles-age:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-R02 | anchor: A02
In the second three months of a junior license the only unsupervised passengers allowed are siblings and parents, so cousins, grandparents and friends must wait until the six month mark [A02].
Why it matters: group passenger stages; difficulty high; prereq sec02-F10; confusables sec02-F12, sec02-F13
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-vt-class-std:vermont-department-of-motor-vehicles-age:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec02-R03 | anchor: A02
Carrying passengers for hire and driving for an employer each cost a junior operator a ninety day recall, while a diversion board recommendation or a texting violation costs thirty days [A02].
Why it matters: group recall terms; difficulty high; prereq sec02-F16; confusables sec02-F16, sec02-F17, sec02-F18
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-vt-class-std:vermont-department-of-motor-vehicles-age:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec02-R04 | anchor: A02
A single speeding violation worth three points triggers the junior operator points recall by itself, the same ninety day recall that a six point total brings [A02].
Why it matters: group recall terms; difficulty medium; prereq sec02-F17; confusables sec02-F17, sec02-F18
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-vt-class-std:vermont-department-of-motor-vehicles-age:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec02-R05 | anchor: A02
The six clean months needed before a junior driver steps up to a full license are counted from the reinstatement date when a recall happened, not from the day the recall began [A02].
Why it matters: group full license eligibility; difficulty medium; prereq sec02-F14; confusables sec02-F14, sec02-F19
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-vt-class-std:vermont-department-of-motor-vehicles-age:handbook:pdf-0022]
